name: Rodinia Gaussian elimination (fan1/fan2 per-column pipeline)
description: Forward substitution via a per-pivot-column two-kernel pipeline (multiplier column + submatrix update), then host back-substitution.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: fan1/fan2 kernels + ForwardSub launch loop + BackSub verbatim; deterministic diagonally-dominant system (scheme has no pivoting). From the HeCBench raw clone, registered as mkp-03.
notes: Fills multi-kernel-pipelines; residual oracle is execution-order independent.
